title: 丐版RS8配置清单（上）
notes: Owner self-build notes (edited 01-09, year not displayed) for an RS8 frame ordered through a dealer and built with Shimano 105 Di2 and third-party steel-spoke carbon wheels. The owner reports being advised to use electronic shifting because the RS8 frame has no mechanical-shift cable ports; XDS has not confirmed this, so it is an owner report rather than a compatibility rule. Owner payment amounts are not used as market prices.
